top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology is a mature, clearly attributable discovery chain: Holst on secretion and the incretin effect, Mojsov on the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) form, and Drucker on its wider actions and the case for targeting them. Independent drugs and large outcome trials confirm the clinical consequence in type 2 diabetes and obesity, so recognition is timely. The three-laureate allocation with a discovery-focused citation fits the prize's remit, and an award is clearly preferable to no award.
